appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Top Hospitals: Nurse Hours vs Discharge Count'.
Subtitle: 'Selected large-volume hospitals shown in dashboard summary'.
Data point labeled 'Hospital E' at approximately (70, 160).
Data point labeled 'Hospital D' at approximately (60, 120).

printed_facts.fact: Hospital E has the highest discharge count (approx. 160k monthly) and highest nurse hours (approx. 70k weekly).
Hospital D has a discharge count of approx. 120k monthly and nurse hours of approx. 60k weekly.
Hospital C has a discharge count of approx. 90k monthly and nurse hours of approx. 50k weekly.
Hospital B has a discharge count of approx. 70k monthly and nurse hours of approx. 40k weekly.
Hospital A has the lowest discharge count (approx. 60k monthly) and lowest nurse hours (approx. 30k weekly).

public_definitions: The dashboard view is for a subset of hospitals.
The decision must be based on the relationship shown in the dashboard.
The options are: Route for full-hospital review, Advance for enterprise approval, or File as background reference.
